name: Shadcn Bento Blocks
summary: 53 bento sections built with React, Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui, installable by copy-paste or the shadcn CLI.
description: A category page of bento-style landing sections for shadcn/ui: feature grids, tiles, mosaics and product blocks, each a self-contained React component. Copy the code or install a block with the shadcn CLI and modify it, since you own the code. Part of the larger shadcnblocks library, which mixes free and Pro blocks.
contains: 53 bento blocks, from Bento 2 to Bento 54
each block is a self-contained React component
copy-paste the code or install via the shadcn CLI
light and dark layouts: analytics, AI chat, voice, ecommerce, healthcare and developer mosaics
